title.zh: 规定将拉古纳省Calamba市陆运署（LTO）延伸办公室改设为正式区办公室，名称为陆运署区办公室，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Conversion of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office in the City of Calamba, Province of Laguna Into a Regular District Office to Be Known as The LTO District Office, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Conversion of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office in the City of Calamba, Province of Laguna Into a Regular District Office to Be Known as The LTO District Office, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office tại Thành phố Calamba, Tỉnh Laguna thành Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy với tên gọi Văn phòng Khu vực LTO, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office ในเมือง Calamba จังหวัด Laguna เป็น สำนักงานเขตปกติในชื่อสำนักงานเขต LTO และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Kantor Perluasan Land Transportation Office di Kota Calamba, Provinsi Laguna menjadi Kantor Distrik Reguler dengan nama Kantor Distrik LTO, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Lanjutan Land Transportation Office di Bandar Calamba, Wilayah Laguna kepada Pejabat Daerah Biasa dengan nama Pejabat Daerah LTO, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2010/ra_10074_2010.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office in the City of Calamba, Province of Laguna is hereby converted into a regular district office to be known as the LTO District Office.
The Department of Transportation and Communications shall issue the necessary rules and regulations to implement the said conversion.
The amount needed for the operationalization of a regular LTO District Office in the City of Calamba, Province of Laguna shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
